source_quality.equation_authority: text layer, running footer corrupts many lines

task_reconstruction.official_task: 2024 MCM Problem C, momentum in a tennis match, addressed to coaches.
required_outputs: a pre-match rating and the server's opening probability
a running estimate of the next point and a momentum measured against it
a test of the claim that in-match form does not matter
a prediction of the swings and the factors behind them
a mix of tactics against a named opponent

section_map.summary: abstract: the disparity, the fenced assumption, the test, the accuracy
introduction: two finals, a borrowed definition, four tasks
assumptions: three bullets, the last one a single line
model-establishment: the rating, the inversion, the blend, the gap
model-establishment: five factors and a fit the prose calls linear

contributions.summary: The IID assumption is used once, to invert the opening probability, and then withdrawn.
The rival model is the same blend with the weight pinned at one.
Momentum is the gap between the running probability and the opening one, with the serve removed.
Five named factors predict the end-of-set trend, and the printed update is not the regression the prose describes.

dependency_graph.label: The first-point probability enters the blend.
The momentum curve is what the series is fit to.
The trend is sampled at the end of each set.
The prediction at a cluster median is the payoff.

assumptions.summary: Players adapt, and the adaptation shows in how they change tactics against an opponent.
The technical indicators characterize the strategy, and changes in them characterize changes in strategy.
The IID assumption holds for the opening point only.

data_and_preprocessing.summary: Four sources: an Elo site, the ATP rankings dated 2023-07-03, the tournament site, and a point-by-point repository.
An error fills the missing serve columns with F. An unknown point fills them with UN.
Galan against Ymer and Pella against Safiullin are dropped, for lack of speed and rally count.
Three indicators are shown and twenty-two are deferred to the appendix.

models.summary: MU-C-Q247-001: Elo rating and a bisection for the first point.
MU-C-Q247-002: the blend, the constant case inside it, and the momentum gap.
MU-C-Q247-003: a Fourier series for the trend, no coefficient valued.
MU-C-Q247-004: five factors and a sigmoid update the prose calls linear.
MU-C-Q247-005: a mixed-strategy equilibrium on four and three clusters.

verification.summary: K-S test, both players far below 0.05, full printed precision.
85.32 percent on the 2023 final, 88.34 percent on the 2017 French Open.
The trend barely moves when the opening probability is changed.

results_trace.summary: Carlos peaks between points 100 and 200 and Nicolas does not.
Near point 130, Carlos passes 0.23 and Nicolas falls to about 0.06.
The two finalists overlap. Murray stays above Kuznetsov.

writing_logic.summary: The summary walks the paper in order and fences the assumption in the same sentence that grants it.
The definition is borrowed and credited before anything is conceded.
The test is described by the failure it would catch.
The unit of prediction is justified by the unit that was refused.
The memo recommends and signs the team.

language_observations.summary: Elucidating the phenomenon wherein. Holds paramount significance. Is not applied to any other value.
This echoed. Highlighting the unpredictable and captivating nature. Was first explored by, who identified.
Setting it to a constant, effectively disregarding. Consequently, ceases to be a factor.
Isn't necessarily. Therefore, it is necessary to eliminate.

Predicted against trend, peak and trough at the end of the second set.

The mix against Tsitsipas. The prose also says Fig.x.

Murray against Kuznetsov, one trend well above the other.

judge_relevance_hypotheses.summary: The paper prints both the linear claim and the sigmoid update, so the contradiction stays visible.
The test statistics are printed in full rather than rounded, and the caption names the wrong table.

weaknesses.summary: The match outcome is coded as 1 for a loss, and the game expansion is unreadable.
The evidence scale that sets the blend is never given a value.
Two of the five factors are named and never described.
The prose says linear and the algorithm is logistic.
The equilibrium probabilities are never printed.

independent_extensions.summary: Value the evidence scale, which the paper defines and never numbers, and rebuild the blend.
Describe the two factors the paper names and never glosses, Endurance and ForehandBias.

candidate_rule_impacts.summary: Fence a borrowed assumption in the same breath that grants it.
Make the rival a special case of your own formula.

unresolved_questions: What value does the evidence scale take?
What do Endurance and ForehandBias load on?
Which fit was run, the linear one in the prose or the logistic one in the algorithm?
What mix does the equilibrium against Tsitsipas actually give?
